# Charlie Sloane

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is a boy notable for his distinctive physical features. He is described as having prominent, goggle eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)_

## Personality

Charlie Sloane harbors ambitious career goals for his future. He aspires to enter the field of politics and ultimately serve as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

In his school days, Charlie Sloane told his mother that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was the smartest girl in school, though he once fought [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md) over a remark Moody made regarding Anne's recitations. Known among his peers for indulging in literary flights and claiming his grandmother saw his deceased grandfather, he was also present during the spring Mayflower gatherings with his schoolmates. Later, Charlie was among the students who joined Miss Stacy's advanced class to prepare for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Charlie and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are classmates who share an ongoing academic and personal rivalry, particularly regarding their efforts to earn the good graces of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their competitive relationship plays out within the classroom setting as both boys pursue their ambitions alongside their peers. While [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) frequently interacts with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) directly, Charlie remains a persistent rival in the background of their social circle.

- presumed Rival of — rivals for the good graces of Anne Shirley (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000)</sub>
